rationale: Core effect: long-horizon return skewness (120-250d) plus proximity to long-term lows (neg minr) with low-vol tilt, rank-combined and delayed 3 days. Train SR 1.83-1.87 for the three picks; the family is robust across about 30 perturbations of horizon, weighting scheme, delay and leg composition (SR 1.4-1.87 throughout), while each leg is individually positive. Three variants at different diversification levels (lean 2-leg, 4-leg, horizon-averaged 5-leg) hedge specification risk while riding the same validated effect.
